desktop.notesZh:
六问题批·第二轮
① 模型菜单显示原始模型名（不再带供应商后缀）
② 模型分级改用 Commander/Reviewer/Worker 命名，中文作职责解释
③ 保底规则文案通俗化（规则逻辑不变：验证失败的返工至少 Reviewer 档）
④ OpenSpec×Matt 融合：产品自带默认工程规则文档，开箱即生效，企业可整体替换
⑤ 更新失败只报「故障码 U-0x + 一句人话」，技术细节进帮助文档故障码表
⑥ 设置→工作流新增「BAF 工程规范」规范总览（只读）：七个插件包规则当前值 + 规则文档全文
desktop.notesEn:
Six-issue round 2
(1) model menus show the raw model name (provider suffixes removed)
(2) tiers renamed Commander/Reviewer/Worker with Chinese duty notes
(3) floor-rule wording made plain (logic unchanged: verify-failed redos run at Reviewer or above)
(4) OpenSpec×Matt fusion: bundled default rules document, active out of the box, enterprise-replaceable
(5) update failures report fault code U-0x + one plain line; details live in the help-doc fault table
(6) Settings→Workflow gains the read-only BAF standards overview: current rule values for all seven packages + the full rules document

dsh.notesZh: 上游 DeepSeek Harness 运行时（会话、工具、Web GUI）
dsh.notesEn: Upstream DeepSeek Harness runtime (session, tools, Web GUI)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesZh: projection、intake、transition、工作流 Tab Remote；full-go-path 七阶段 + drift/abandon/T11；Phase 6 bug 快路径与 T15 升级；Phase 7 verify CheckRunner 接入 stack/guard adapter；§22.17 J：分类弹窗两路径改道（intake-mode-set）+ 缺陷草案五字段 + auto-pop 宿主行（状态驱动自动弹）+ 门弹窗通道；卡死修复 A–G：/baf-go 直绑唯一活跃变更、铸造设焦点、已确认未 open 不重弹、Tab 恢复按钮、mode= 硬要求、setIntakeMode 补救臂、git_unavailable 审计；OpenSpec×Matt 融合：会话提示词节 baf:standard-rules 每回合注入工程规则源

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-openspec.notesZh: OpenSpec 本地文件适配器：骨架、校验、原子归档；design/tasks 模板 TODO 提示规则源锚点（偏离需注明、测试遵循 testing-discipline）

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesZh: baseline 摘要 + 提示词渲染：产品默认规则文档 .baf/standards/default-rules.md 开箱即挂接（8 规则域，企业改 mattPocockRulesRef 整体替换）；占位态返回 policy_missing，给出 sourceRef#anchor 指引
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesEn: Baseline summary + prompt render: the bundled default rules document wires up out of the box (8 rule areas; enterprises repoint mattPocockRulesRef to swap wholesale); placeholder state returns policy_missing with sourceRef#anchor guidance

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesZh: C 栈质量执行器：build/test/coverage/analyzer 命令注入；占位态返回 policy_missing 与工具版本
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesEn: C stack quality executor: build/test/coverage/analyzer command injection; placeholder state returns policy_missing and tool versions

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesZh: 工具调用硬门禁：fs/shell 同步裁决 + projection 重读 + 密钥扫描 + 危险/间接 shell 模式识别；install row 注入每个 agent 的 tools.guard；§22.17 J 未决门期间拦截通用提问工具（gate_pending_ask_blocked）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesEn: Tool-call hard gate: synchronous fs/shell adjudication + projection re-read + secret scan + dangerous/indirect shell pattern detection; install row hooks tools.guard for every agent

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-scaffold.notesZh: 工作区 init 骨架三产物：基线配置 + 默认工程规则文档（.baf/standards/default-rules.md）+ openspec 目录；人工确认才落盘，差异文件走 .baf-backup-<时间戳> 备份
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-scaffold.notesEn: Workspace init skeleton, three artifacts: baseline config + default rules document (.baf/standards/default-rules.md) + openspec layout; requires human confirmation, divergent files moved to .baf-backup-<timestamp>
